events.text: Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Manchester City 1. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Antoine Semenyo with a cross.
Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
